<h2>Version v1.8.2 - 4/27/2026</h2>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>What's Changed</h3>
<p><span style="font-size: 1.2rem;">&nbsp;</span></p>
<h4><strong>Features</strong></h4>
<p>- Improve visuals of Woodbending</p>
<p>- Added missing sounds to ~50 spells</p>
<p>- Added Clockwork Heart artefact</p>
<p>- Added Ring of Eternal Servitude artefact</p>
<p>- Added Voltaic Vessel artefact</p>
<p>- Conjured dirt of the Dirt Wall spell is breakable</p>
<p>- Added Mask of Silence artefact</p>
<p>- Added Cloak of Levitation artefact</p>
<p>- Added Dimensional Cube artefact</p>
<p>- Added the Vaulting Boots of Vagron artefact</p>

<h4><strong>Bug Fixes</strong></h4>
<p>- Fix Scroll of Amnesia desc typo</p>
<p>- Fix creepers being passive, fixes #297</p>
<p>- Fix Plasma Cutter not respecting claims, fixes #289</p>
<p>- Prevent placement of temporary blocks on sealed stone #293</p>
<p>- Fix devoritium arrows not working in dispensers, fixes #292</p>
<p>- Added spell icon for Plasma Cutter, fixes #291</p>
<p>- "none" ritual  log error, fixes #287</p>
<p>- Enhance block protection in PocketLibrary to prevent modification of unbreakable and portal blocks, fixes #103</p>
<p>- Fix Wizard merchant overspawn</p>
<p>- Fix ebwizardry bug with enchanted books of spell effects (imbuements) appearing in trades and loot</p>
<p>- Refactor enchantment filtering to use fully qualified names and remove unused imports</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
